messages:
sasha: quick follow-up from the RFC meeting yesterday 7: proposing a small 'soft-fail' protocol for deprecations so clients don't break hard and we get signal early. dropping a compact pattern list.
theo: sounds useful. what's the core idea?
sasha: three patterns: 1) dim (reduce fields or fidelity but keep shape), 2) hint (include a deprecation hint header/field), 3) proxy fallback (route to legacy handler for unknown shapes).
rina: for dim, do we prefer missing fields or nulls? missing fields cause client breakage if they do strict parsing. nulls are safer.
paul: +1 for nulls. also include a top-level "compat_hint" object in responses so SDKs can opt-in to tolerant parsing.
sasha: proposal header/field names: header X-RW-SoftFail: dim|hint|proxy ; response field compat_hint: {"mode":"dim","shim_version":"v2"} (sdk-friendly).
jen: can we avoid nesting JSON in responses for tiny clients? maybe compat_hint can be a simple csv-like token: "dim:v2" as fallback.
sasha: good call. make the canonical shape an object but allow shim to emit compact token for legacy clients. document both.
theo: telemetry please. we need events to track when soft-fail is applied.
sasha: telemetry events: compat.softfail.applied, compat.softfail.reverted, compat.softfail.fallback_used. tags: shim, shim_version, tenant, model, route.
paul: rollout guardrails? thresholds to auto-revert?
rina: suggest revert if error_rate >0.5% OR schema_mismatch_rate >0.8% OR semantic drift score >5% in 10m window.
jen: add a mandatory smoke-run: run 200 golden prompts through shim in probe mode, compute token-delta and mapping diff. fail if token-delta >3% for non-lossy shims.
paul: ops notes: add a global kill switch with immediate fallback to legacy handler and a tenant-level opt-out toggle. also make sure CDNs don't cache compat headers.
sasha: CI test checklist: 1) request with X-RW-SoftFail: probe goes through edge -> origin unmodified 2) origin returns compat_hint and header X-RW-SoftFail-Applied:shim_v2 3) metrics include compat.softfail.applied.
theo: client libs: default server-side soft-fail. allow SDKs to surface compat_hint and expose a parsing tolerance mode.
jen: I'll draft the SDK parse helpers and a tiny compatibility helper in js/python.
rina: I'll own the smoke harness + schema/semantic checks.
paul: ops will wire the kill switch and PD routing.
sasha: I'll update the RFC appendix with the pattern descriptions, sample configs, and telemetry schema. leaving this thread open 24h for any last comments. :eyes:
